page.description: GhostBSD editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A desktop BSD built on FreeBSD, with the MATE desktop and a graphical installer. One amd64 image.
pros: FreeBSD underneath, with a desktop and installer ready to use.
MATE desktop configured out of the box.
The same base as FreeBSD, so the handbook's material applies.
One image, so no edition matrix.
cons: Not Linux: Linux-only drivers and tools do not apply.
No support window is published, so none is stated here.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for GhostBSD; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One path: the amd64 ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk.
